Mehr als ein Job

Ob internationale Fachmesse oder regionale Ausstellung: Als Teamleiter:in Nationale Messelogistik mit Dienstsitz in Basel verantwortest du unsere Aktivitäten an den Standorten Basel und Zürich. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team sorgst du dafür, dass komplexe Messeprojekte reibungslos geplant, gesteuert und umgesetzt werden.

‎

Du bringst Menschen, Waren und Termine zusammen und schaffst die Grundlage für überzeugende Messeauftritte. So trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden ihre Marken und Produkte erfolgreich präsentieren können.

Wie du dich einbringst

  • Ansprechperson für Messegesellschaften, Kunden und weitere Stakeholder
  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des kaufmännischen und technischen Teams inkl. Einsatzplanung, Schulung und Qualitätssicherung
  • Verantwortung für Budget, Kosten und wirtschaftliche Ergebnisse des Bereichs
  • Erstellung von Angeboten und Koordination eingehender Aufträge
  • Eigenständige Abwicklung von Transporten per Luft-, See- und Landfracht
  • Planung, Steuerung und Überwachung von Messeprojekten sowie Vor-Ort-Betreuung während der Veranstaltungen
  • Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen, Servicequalität und Kundenzufriedenheit

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Spedition und Logistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Berufserfahrung in der Logistikbranche, idealerweise in der Messelogistik
  • Ausgeprägte Führungskompetenz sowie Freude daran, Mitarbeitende zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ein hohes Maß an Kunden- und Kostenorientierung
  • Hands-on-Mentalität und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Bereitschaft zu Einsätzen an Wochenenden, Feiertagen sowie zu Dienstreisen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Führerschein der Klasse B von Vorteil

Was für dich drin ist

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket inklusive 13. Monatslohn
  • Umfangreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Exklusive Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Partnerunternehmen
  • Mitarbeiterwerbungsprogramm mit attraktiver Prämie
  • Regelmässige Team- und Firmenevents

Wer wir sind

Logistik berührt jeden Aspekt unseres Lebens – von den Gütern, die wir täglich konsumieren bis zur Gesundheitsversorgung, auf die wir uns verlassen. Bei uns geht deine Arbeit über Logistik hinaus: Sie ermöglicht die kleinen und grossen Momente des Lebens für Menschen auf der ganzen Welt.

Als ein global führendes Logistikunternehmen mit der Vision, unsere Welt weiterzuentwickeln, bieten wir dir ein sicheres und stabiles Umfeld. Hier macht deine Arbeit einen echten Unterschied. Ob die Lieferung von Lebensmitteln, die Entwicklung nachhaltiger Transportlösungen oder das Engagement für lokale Gemeinschaften – deine Arbeit bewirkt mehr, als du dir vorstellen kannst.

descriptionByLocale.en:
More than a job

Whether international trade fair or regional exhibition: As a team leader: in Basel-based National Exhibition Logistics, you are responsible for our activities at the Basel and Zurich locations. Together with your team, you ensure that complex trade fair projects are smoothly planned, controlled and implemented.

You bring people, goods and dates together and create the basis for convincing trade fair appearances. In this way, you help our customers to successfully present their brands and products.

How you get involved

  • Contact person for trade fair companies, customers and other stakeholders
  • Expert and disciplinary management of the commercial and technical team incl. Operation planning, training and quality assurance
  • responsibility for budget, costs and economic results of the area
  • Creation of offers and coordination of incoming orders
  • Independent handling of transports by air, sea and land freight
  • Planning, control and monitoring of trade fair projects as well as on-site support during events

What sets you apart

  • Completed training in the field of forwarding and logistics or a comparable qualification
  • Professional experience in the logistics sector, ideally in trade fair logistics
  • Extensive leadership skills as well as pleasure in motivating and developing employees
  • negotiation skills as well as a high degree of customer and cost orientation
  • Working method
  • Readiness for assignments on weekends, holidays and on business trips
  • Very good German and English skills in word and writing
  • Driving license of class B of advantage

jobs.description:
Mehr als ein Job

Im Kontraktlogistikteam bei Kühne+Nagel verantwortest du Lagerhaltungsvorgänge, wie z. B. die Kommissionierung von Waren. Dabei arbeitest du präzise und trägst damit nicht nur zum Erfolg deines Teams bei, sondern sorgst auch für ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft in unseren Lager- und Distributionszentren. Mit deiner Arbeit ermöglichst du z. B. die Lagerung und Lieferung von Blumen und frischen Zutaten für schönes Ambiente und leckeres Essen in deinem Lieblingsrestaurant. Logistik bei Kühne+Nagel ist mehr, als du dir vorstellen kannst.
‎

Als Service- und Anlagentechniker spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserer Intralogistik: Mit deinem technischen Know-how hältst du unsere automatisierten Systeme zuverlässig am Laufen, arbeitest eng mit Logistikteams und externen Technikern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass unser Standort technisch auf Topniveau bleibt.

Wie du dich einbringst

  • Du führst Wartungs-, Inspektions- und Reparaturarbeiten an automatisierten Lager- und Förderanlagen durch.

  • Du analysierst Störungen und sorgst für eine schnelle und nachhaltige Instandsetzung.

  • Du betreust Regalbediengeräte, Shuttles, Heber, Rollenbahnen und weitere intralogistische Systeme.

  • Du arbeitest mit Sensorik, Aktorik, Lichtschranken und Scannertechnik.

  • Du unterstützt bei Umbauten, Optimierungen und Erweiterungen der Anlagen.

  • Du überwachst sicherheitsrelevante Einrichtungen wie Not-Aus-Kreise und Brandschutzsysteme.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeiten und stimmst dich mit internen Teams sowie externen Technikern ab.

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, z. B. Elektroinstallateur EFZ / Elektroniker EFZ, Automatiker / Industrieelektriker oder Mechatroniker

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Elektrotechnik, Schaltplanlesen und Messverfahren.

  • Mechanische Grundkenntnisse (Riemen, Ketten, Lager, Führungen).

  • Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Maschinen oder automatisierten Anlagen.

  • Selbstständige, zuverlässige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Freude an praktischer Arbeit im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Teamfähigkeit und klare Kommunikation.

  • Bereitschaft zu Schichtarbeit oder Pikettdienst.

  • Belastbarkeit und schnelle Entscheidungsfähigkeit.

  • Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was für dich drin ist

  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung: Profitiere von einem attraktiven Gehaltspaket inklusive 13. Monatsgehalt
  • Perspektive: Schulungsangebote für fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung wie z. B. Sprachkurse und Entwicklungsprogramme
  • Rabatte: Diverse Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Kooperationspartnern aus den Bereichen Mode, Freizeit, Elektronik, Wohnen & Co.
  • Teamarbeit: Team- und Firmenevents

descriptionByLocale.it:
Più di un lavoro Nel team di logistica contrattuale di Kühne+Nagel, sei responsabile delle operazioni di stoccaggio, come la raccolta di merci. Lavori con precisione e non solo contribuisce al successo del tuo team, ma assicura anche un'attività quotidiana agevole nei nostri centri di magazzino e distribuzione. Con il tuo lavoro, puoi, ad esempio, conservare e consegnare fiori e ingredienti freschi per una bella atmosfera e deliziosi cibi nel tuo ristorante del comune di Kühne+Nagel.

Come tecnico di servizio e impianti, svolgete un ruolo chiave nella nostra intralogistica: con il vostro know-how tecnico, potete mantenere i nostri sistemi automatizzati in funzione in modo affidabile, lavorare a stretto contatto con team logistici e tecnici esterni e garantire che la nostra posizione rimanga tecnicamente al livello superiore.

Come ti metti in contatto

- Si effettuano lavori di manutenzione, ispezione e riparazione su sistemi automatizzati di stoccaggio e trasporto.

- Analizza i difetti e assicura una riparazione veloce e sostenibile.

- È possibile mantenere dispositivi di funzionamento scaffale, shuttle, hebers, rulli trasportatori e altri sistemi intralogistici.

- Lavori con sensori, attuatori, barriere luminose e tecnologia a scanner.

- Supportate la conversione, l'ottimizzazione ed estensione dei sistemi.

- Si monitorano dispositivi di sicurezza come circuiti di emergenza e sistemi antincendio.

- Documentate il vostro lavoro e sintonizzatevi con squadre interne e tecnici esterni.

Cosa ti fa risaltare

- Formazione tecnica completata, ad esempio elettro-fitter EFZ / produttore di elettronica EFZ, elettrotecnico automatico / industriale o meccanico

- Buona conoscenza dell'ingegneria elettrica, dei metodi di lettura e misurazione schematici.

- Conoscenze meccaniche di base (cinghie, catene, cuscinetti, guide).

- esperienza nella manutenzione di macchine o sistemi automatizzati.

- Metodi di lavoro autonomi, affidabili e orientati alla soluzione.

- Godersi il lavoro pratico in azienda.

- Abilità di squadra e comunicazione chiara.

- disponibilità al lavoro a turni o servizio di piket.

- Resilienza e decisione rapida.

- Conoscenza sicura del tedesco e dell'inglese in termini di parole e scrittura

Cosa ci guadagni?

- beneficiare di un pacchetto salariale attraente compreso 13 mesi di stipendio

- Prospettiva: Corsi di formazione per lo sviluppo professionale e personale, come corsi di lingua e programmi di sviluppo

- sconti: diversi sconti con numerosi partner di cooperazione nei settori della moda, del tempo libero, dell'elettronica, della vita e della co-co.

- Lavoro di squadra: Eventi di squadra e aziendali

Chi siamo

La logistica tocca ogni aspetto della nostra vita. dalle merci che consumiamo ogni giorno alla sanità su cui ci basiamo.Il vostro lavoro va oltre la logistica: permette i piccoli e grandi momenti di vita per le persone di tutto il mondo.

Come azienda logistica globale con una visione di sviluppo del nostro mondo, vi offriamo un ambiente sicuro e stabile. Qui, il vostro lavoro fa una vera differenza. Che si tratti di fornitura di cibo, lo sviluppo di soluzioni di trasporto sostenibili o impegno sociale, il vostro lavoro fa più di quanto si possa immaginare.

Chiediamo alle agenzie di intermediazione di presentare nessun profilo senza essere richiesto. Tutti i profili dei candidati inviati senza previo accordo sono considerati nostri beni e non vengono pagate tasse.
descriptionByLocale.en:
More than a job In the contract logistics team at Kühne+Nagel, you are responsible for storage operations, such as picking goods. You are working precisely and not only contributes to the success of your team, but also ensures smooth day-to-day business in our warehouse and distribution centers. With your work, you can, for example, store and deliver flowers and fresh ingredients for a beautiful ambience and delicious food in your favorite restaurant. Logistics at Kühne+Nagel is more than you can imagine.

As a service and plant technician, you play a key role in our intralogistics: with your technical know-how, you can keep our automated systems running reliably, work closely with logistics teams and external technicians and ensure that our location remains technically at the top level.

How you get in touch

- You perform maintenance, inspection and repair work on automated storage and conveying systems.

- You analyze faults and ensure a fast and sustainable repair.

- You can maintain shelf operating devices, shuttles, hebers, roller conveyors and other intralogistic systems.

- You work with sensors, actuators, light barriers and scanner technology.

- You support the conversion, optimization and extension of the systems.

- You monitor safety-related devices such as emergency-off circuits and fire protection systems.

- You document your work and tune with internal teams and external technicians.

What makes you stand out

- Completed technical training, e.g. electro fitter EFZ / electronics manufacturer EFZ, automatic / industrial electrician or mechatronics engineer

- Good knowledge of electrical engineering, schematic reading and measuring methods.

- Basic mechanical knowledge (belts, chains, bearings, guides).

- experience in the maintenance of machines or automated systems.

- Self-employed, reliable and solution-oriented working methods.

- Enjoying practical work in the company.

- Team skills and clear communication.

- willingness to shiftwork or piket service.

- Resilience and quick decision-making.

- Secure German and English knowledge in word and writing

What's in it for you

- Benefit from an attractive salary package including 13 months' salary

- Perspective: Training courses for professional and personal development, such as language courses and development programmes

- Discounts: Various discounts with numerous cooperation partners from the fields of fashion, leisure, electronics, living & co.

- Teamwork: Team and company events

Who we are

Logistics touches every aspect of our lives – from the goods we consume every day to the health care we rely on. Your work goes beyond logistics: it allows the small and large moments of life for people all over the world.

As a global logistics company with a vision of developing our world, we offer you a safe and stable environment. Here, your work makes a real difference. Whether it's the supply of food, the development of sustainable transport solutions or social commitment, your work does more than you can imagine.

jobs.title: Global Program Manager Healthcare (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.

‎

Join Kuehne+Nagel as our Global Program Manager Healthcare and play a key role in shaping the future of healthcare logistics. In this highly visible global role, you will drive strategic initiatives, lead cross-business unit programs, and strengthen collaboration across our Healthcare vertical. This position offers the opportunity to develop strategy while ensuring successful execution, working closely with stakeholders around the world to deliver meaningful business impact and customer value.

How you create impact

  • Support the further development and execution of the global Healthcare strategy and roadmap.
  • Lead cross-business unit customer implementations and strategic healthcare initiatives.
  • Drive collaboration and alignment across functions, regions, and business units.
  • Establish and facilitate governance structures, ensuring clear decision-making and follow-up.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement, operational performance, and internal collaboration.
  • Develop and share healthcare-specific content, industry insights, and best practices.
  • Coordinate customer-facing activities, including advisory councils and industry engagement initiatives.
  • Manage programs from concept to implementation, delivering measurable business outcomes.

What we would like you to bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
  • 10+ years of experience in program, project, or business management within the pharmaceutical, healthcare or MedTech industry.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy and translate it into successful execution.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions in a global matrix organization.
  • Highly self-organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in a flexible role with evolving priorities.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex global projects and cross-functional teams.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English and willing to travel internationally.

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, you'll join one of the world's leading logistics providers, connecting people and businesses across a global network. • We offer an international and collaborative working environment where your expertise is valued, your ideas are welcomed, and your contribution has a tangible impact. If you are passionate about delivering exceptional service and enjoy working in a dynamic, people-focused role, Kuehne+Nagel offers exciting opportunities for professional growth and development.

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

  • Professional background in warehousing or contract logistics.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, a strong customer service orientation, and a collaborative team spirit.

  • Effective English communication skills;
  • Knowledge of SQL and Moca.
  • 1st Level Support Experience

At Kühne + Nagel, you are always part of a dedicated and dynamic team because great achievements can only happen together. Join us on our journey with the vision of enhancing our innovative logistics solutions even further. • We offer genuine professional and personal growth opportunities in a secure work environment.
